sql: SELECT t.team_long_name FROM "Match" AS m JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id JOIN Team AS t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m.season = '2009/2010' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
